protocol_title: AEGIS-ML Phase 22: False-Positive Reduction, Confidence Calibration, and Robust Detection Evaluation

phase21_baseline_reproduction.reproduced_config: Phase 21 Config C (48 features: Config E + Sequence minus 2 inferred cross-net)
phase21_baseline_reproduction.note: Phase 21 Config C metrics reproduced from fresh model training on identical scenario-grouped partition (seed 42). Minor floating-point variations possible from val/train split; stored Phase 21 predictions confirmed consistent.

split_methodology.strategy: Scenario-grouped stratified partitioning: 70% train, 10% val, 20% test

calibration_methodology.note: RFC predict_proba gives tree-vote fractions, not calibrated posteriors. Isotonic calibration fitted on non-resampled validation data maps vote fractions to better-calibrated probability estimates. ECE computed using 10-bin uniform binning. Brier score computed one-vs-rest. Limitation: validation set (~10%) may be small for isotonic regression on minority classes.

threshold_methodology.global_threshold_objective: Minimize benign FPR on validation while maintaining binary attack recall >= 0.95. Grid search over [0.0, 0.99] in 100 steps.
threshold_methodology.class_specific_threshold_objective: Per-class: find minimum threshold maintaining class recall >= 0.95 on validation. Predict attack class only when P(class) >= class threshold. If multiple classes qualify, predict highest probability.
threshold_methodology.conflict_resolution: Highest probability attack class wins when multiple exceed threshold.
threshold_methodology.test_data_usage_during_selection: NONE - test data never accessed during selection.

known_limitations: All evaluation is on synthetic cybersecurity data; not validated on real enterprise telemetry.
Verified process-to-socket attribution is 0.0% in the test set; no Level 2 evidence available.
Process ancestry observed in only 0.5% of test events; ancestry-based features provide minimal signal.
bulk_read_archive (100%), scheduled_backup (83%), and smb_file_sharing (50%) false alarms persist because local file utilities are indistinguishable from staging utilities at single-event level.
Isotonic calibration may overfit on small minority-class validation samples.
Multi-seed robustness uses different partitions of the same synthetic dataset; not true cross-dataset generalization.
